overview: A ride-hailing web app MVP connecting Karatina campus and Karatina town. Passengers request rides, drivers accept and track them in real-time, with fixed KSh 100 pricing.
features: Passenger and driver role selection after login
Request a ride with pickup and destination
Real-time driver location tracking on a map
Driver online/offline toggle and ride acceptance
Fixed KSh 100 fare with trip completion flow
Live ride status updates from searching to completed
